summary.name: Decktopus AI
summary.one_liner: Decktopus AI is an AI presentation maker that generates on-brand decks and LinkedIn/Instagram carousels from a text description, with a rehearsal coach (Loop) and view tracking for shared decks.
use_cases: Generate a pitch deck from a topic or rough notes
Write client proposals and reports as slides
Practise presentation delivery with AI feedback
Share decks as live links and see who views them
Turn a resource deck into an email lead magnet
summary.what_it_does: Decktopus AI takes a topic, uploaded files, or rough notes and generates a structured, visual presentation with slides, which can be edited by describing changes in prompts. It can redesign an existing uploaded presentation's look (colors, layout, fonts) while keeping the content unchanged, and apply a brand kit. Shared decks are delivered as live links that update when the deck is edited, with viewer tracking (who opened it, time spent, slides stalled on) and an optional email gate to capture leads. Loop, its AI delivery coach, offers rehearsal and real-time feedback across sessions. Decks export to PPT and PDF.
notable: Loop AI delivery coach with real-time feedback and memory across rehearsal sessions
Live shared links plus per-slide viewer analytics and email-gated lead capture
Redesigns an uploaded presentation's look while keeping its content unchanged
Works inside ChatGPT and connects to Claude or MCP-ready assistants
caveats: Some team and brand features are described as part of Business plans; exact pricing is not stated on the page
Comparison table is the vendor's own and not independently verified
Listing tags it as freemium; the page itself does not detail free-tier limits
